_status: USCIS's published processing-time estimates, copied untouched from USCIS's own page with the date read; never worked out, never rounded. The client's page shows an entry only when its form and office match a receipt the case holds (src/client_case.py estimate). The page https://egov.uscis.gov/processing-times/ was NOT read on 10/03/2026: it refused the request (HTTP 403, a bot check), so no entry is held and no client sees an estimate. The register item uscis_processing_times says what to do each month.

_entry.form: the form's number as USCIS's page names it (I-485)
_entry.form_type: the category USCIS's page names, if the page asks for one (kept as written)
_entry.office: the service center or field office exactly as the page names it
_entry.receipt_prefixes: the three letters a receipt number starts with at that office (LIN, SRC, WAC, EAC, MSC, IOE): the entry shows only for a case holding a receipt of that form that begins with one of them; leave the list empty for an entry that applies to every receipt of the form
_entry.months: the figure for most cases, exactly as the page prints it (a text, never a number we computed)
_entry.read_on: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the page was read
